name: Demesne Arbalists
headerMeta: Silver era · Ranged Infantry · Crossbow · 160 leadership · Tier 3 / Mastery
pitch: High per-shot damage ranged unit that demands close positioning to deal impact—the 2026-06-25 Piercing Bolts nerf (target count 2→1, fire rate −16%) strips away its multi-target value and may force a playstyle shift. Stack Double Fire + Bolt Penetration to recover shot count and damage scaling.

doctrines.name: Double Fire Doctrine
doctrines.note: unlocks Double Fire (unit-unique, can't combine with Focus Fire, 45s CD), +12% rate of fire, +1 shot to spell (6→7 arrows)

doctrines.name: Bolt Penetration Doctrine
doctrines.note: +1 additional target penetration on top of baseline Penetrating Shots

doctrines.name: Epic Crossbow II
doctrines.note: +50 piercing DMG, +200 piercing penetration; alt if no Ammo Doctrine or no Unit Damage V

veterancy.label: Top Line
veterancy.body: Do NOT take the last node.

battleRole.positioning: Huge damage drop-off — position within brawl range to deal impact; press 2 extends reach. {1}
battleRole.tips: Never overlap Double Fire with Double Shot; execute them sequentially. {1} Either Double Fire + rate-of-fire doctrine or basic rate-of-fire adds +1 shot to spell (6→7 arrows); Bolt Penetration is also mandatory. {1}
